name: spellkave_equip_item
label: Equip Item (verb)
description: sk-9ll.3: equip an already-placed, already-stowed item into a named equipment slot on an actor (actor_equipment_slots, upsert-by-(actor_entity_key, slot_id)) — folds the 'give the hero a starter weapon' idiom's raw actor_equipment_slots write into one checked call. `slot_id` existence and `item_entity_key`'s existence/placeability are enforced by the SAME validator the linter and manifest admission use (no bespoke re-check here); THIS call's own precondition is the one thing only it can see across separate tool calls — a slot already occupied by a DIFFERENT item is a hard rejection (matches the runtime EquipItem affordance's SlotAlreadyOccupied check), while re-equipping the SAME item into the SAME slot is idempotent.

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on the generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

actor_entity_key.description: actor_equipment_slots.actor_entity_key — must already carry an actor_spatial_locations row (workspace, live, or the active target); place it first via spellkave_place_actor.

item_entity_key.description: actor_equipment_slots.item_key — an already-authored entities row that entity_containment already places inside actor_entity_key (stow it first via spellkave_stow_item).

slot_id.description: actor_equipment_slots.slot_id — must already resolve to an authored equipment_slot_definitions row.
